 Nicki Minaj gushes over 'great guy' Trump as she joins president on Air Force One
 Jorge Solis Updated 2026년 10월 25일 일 오후 5:36 UTC 0 Nicki Minaj shared her flight on Air Force One -Credit:Reach Publishing Services Limited (Reach Publishing Services Limited) Nicki Minaj shared footage from her flight on Air Force One. 
 On October 25, Minaj, 43, took to social media to share a brief clip from her trip on Air Force One ahead of her Michigan rally with President Trump , 80. In the nearly 40-second clip, the Trinidadian rap star showed off her checkerboard blazer. White House Director of Communications Steven Cheung took to X to share footage of himself and the singer during their discussion. Minaj boasted that the president is such "a great guy" and how "he surely knows what to do with the country" as a "businessman."
 Cheung captioned the post, "Ladies and gentlemen, I think we may have found the new White House Press Secretary!" This came after a Fox News host awkwardly cut off the president amid his rambling live interview. 
 • Nicki Minaj warns she's 'not going anywhere' as Donald Trump shares his verdict on the rapper 
 • DJ rushes to turn off Nicki Minaj song as crowd boos after she fawns over Donald Trump 
 In the first clip, Minaj wrote the hashtag, #AirForceBarbie, while filming the interior of the customized Boeing jumbo jet.
 Towards the end of the clip, she was introduced to the White House Director as an off-screen individual said, "Thank you. This is a very special person to us. Mr. Steven Cheung. He is in charge of messaging strategy for the White House."
 Advertisement
 In the following clip, Cheung sat across from the music superstar on a rectangular-shaped table. 
 Cheung asked her, "Where do you think the economy is with President Trump?"
 Minaj replied, "Well, we have a president who understands economics first of all. You know, I've said before that the president is, nationally, a businessman. He's worked his way out of not having a dollar left in the bank. 
 "If he can do that himself, with his own finances, surely he knows what to do with the country. He's tough internationally. He tells them what we need, not what they need."
 Cheung then questioned her if she could name anyone "who works harder than the president?"
 The Right Thru Me singer answered, "Absolutely not!" and claimed, "The man won three elections!"
 She went on, "He wakes up at four o'clock in the morning. He outworks people who are half his age. You, what does that say about his character? He's paying it forward. He's thinking about the other Republicans who have to win in this election. 
 "That tells me that he's a great guy," she boasted while closing.
